title.value: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS
title.provenance: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Assembly convened:

reference.value: Substitute Senate Bill No. 292, Public Act No. 24-59
reference.provenance: Substitute Senate Bill No. 292, Public Act No. 24-59

status.provenance: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Assembly convened:

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or 'PFAS' means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person shall manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale

who.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale

action.provenance: no person shall manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale

products.provenance: no person shall manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale any ... products if such product contains intentionally added PFAS

value: products for which federal law governs or requires the presence of PFAS
products regulated under section 22a-903a or 22a-255i of the general statutes
the sale or resale of a used product
prosthetic, orthotic device or product that is a medical device or drug
products made with not less than eighty-five per cent recycled content
products manufactured prior to any prohibition imposed by the provisions of this section
replacement parts for any product manufactured prior to any prohibition imposed by the provisions of this section
exceptions.provenance: The provisions of this section shall not be construed to apply to ... or (7) any product manufactured prior to any prohibition imposed by the provisions of this section.

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added PFAS during the manufacture of a product

type.provenance: products listed in subdivision (1) of this subsection shall be labeled

who.provenance: The manufacturer shall apply any product and package labels

action.provenance: products listed in subdivision (1) of this subsection shall be labeled

products.provenance: On and after January 1, 2026, no person shall manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this state any ... if such product contains intentionally added PFAS, unless such product is labeled in accordance with this subsection.

exceptions.provenance: No specific exceptions mentioned for labeling
